Jonas — thanks for the ping. I reviewed their suggested phrasing. Below is our recommended public-facing sentence and a slightly longer console blurb suitable for procurement teams. I also attached a drafted docx with tracked changes for the DPA companion page.

Recommended one-line (vendor register):
"Redwood Inference transfers Customer Data internationally under EU Standard Contractual Clauses (or another lawful transfer mechanism where applicable) and maintains technical and organizational safeguards equivalent to applicable data protection laws."

Console help modal (short paragraph):
"Redwood operates a published list of subprocessors that perform services on our behalf. We update the public list immediately when subprocessors are added or removed; customers receive email notification for material changes that affect the processing of Customer Data. Customers may review the current list at [link] and request objections in accordance with the DPA."

Notes and concessions:
- We should avoid promising a strict '30-day notice' window unless Sales confirms operational readiness to enforce it.
- We can commit to SCCs (or equivalent) where needed; avoid specifying a single mechanism in public copy — keep it 'lawful transfer mechanism(s)'.
